stops.date_confidence: Attested: the IMEC press release gives 4 April 2016, Marine Baudrillard as donor, and the contents as corrected typescripts, notebooks, dossiers of preparatory notes, working files, editorial files, annotated books and iconographic and audiovisual material. The fonds page 787BDL carries the phrase about the destruction of traces verbatim. Baudrillard never visited the Abbaye d'Ardenne; this stop marks where his working papers physically are, not a journey he made. Coordinate corrected to 49.1964, -0.4139; the research pool carried two different wrong values.
